title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
description: Req ID: 142335Remote Position: HybridRegion: AsiaCountry: IndiaState/Province: ChennaiCity: Guindy, ChennaiSummaryWe are seeking a senior technical leader for the role of Infrastructure Automation Manager to direct and execute our enterprise-wide end-to-end automation strategy. This role bridges traditional on-premises data centers, private cloud hypervisors, container platforms, and public cloud environments into a unified, code-driven delivery ecosystem.With 12 to 15 years of industry experience, you will manage a specialized team of automation, infrastructure, and network reliability engineers. You will drive declarative infrastructure practices across bare-metal systems, hyperconverged/virtualization layers (Nutanix AHV, VMware vSphere), enterprise container fleets (Red Hat OpenShift, native Kubernetes), and software-defined network hardware (Cisco, Arista, Juniper switches and routers). You will own the full operational lifecycle—from architecture alignment and automated rollouts to fleet hygiene, automated DR failover, L3 support escalations, and executive operational reporting.Detailed DescriptionPerforms tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:Enterprise Automation Framework: Define and enforce declarative automation standards across hybrid environments spanning on-premise data centers, private clouds, and multi-cloud landing zones.Virtualization & HCI Automation: Architect automated provisioning, node expansion, and policy baselines across VMware vSphere/vCenter (vROps, PowerCLI, Terraform vSphere provider) and Nutanix AHV/Prism Central (Calm, Prism APIs).Container Platform Orchestration: Standardize deployment, node scaling, and operator lifecycle automations for Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes clusters across bare metal and virtual platforms.Network as Code (NetDevOps): Champion automated configuration, deployment, and validation of physical and virtual network infrastructure (leaf-spine fabrics, switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers) using Ansible, NAPALM, Nornir, and NetBox as a single source of truth.Unified Pipeline Orchestration: Build and manage enterprise GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) that drive zero-touch provisioning for compute, storage, virtualization, and network layers.Multi-Tier IaC & Configuration: Direct the authoring, testing, and modularization of production-grade Terraform modules, Ansible playbooks, Python automation frameworks, and Kubernetes Helm/Kustomize manifests.Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP): Establish automated PXE/IPXE booting, bare-metal imaging, switch boot-strapping, and dynamic host/hypervisor configuration workflows.Rolling Cluster & Hypervisor Lifecycle: Coordinate and automate rolling non-disruptive upgrades across VMware ESXi, Nutanix AOS/AHV, and OpenShift/Kubernetes worker and control-plane nodes.Configuration Drift & Compliance: Implement continuous drift detection and compliance auditing tools to guarantee that on-prem hardware, network device configurations, and cloud workloads strictly match source-controlled code baselines.Automated Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Build automated orchestration pipelines for monthly firmware updates, hypervisor security patches, base OS updates, and network OS (NOS) upgrades.L3 Operational Support: Serve as the senior escalation manager for critical automation, networking, hypervisor, and platform outages, leading cross-functional debugging sessions. Knowledge/Skills/CompetenciesVirtualization & HCI: Extensive, production-level expertise automating and administering VMware vSphere/vCenter and Nutanix (AOS, AHV, Prism Central).Container Orchestration: Hands-on experience configuring, automating, and operating Red Hat OpenShift and native Kubernetes at scale (CNI, CSI, Operators, Helm, Kustomize).NetDevOps & Network Automation: Proven track record automating physical switch and router configurations (Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos) using NetBox, Ansible, Python (Netmiko, Nornir), or Terraform.Automation & IaC Tooling: Deep proficiency with Terraform, Ansible/Ansible Automation Platform (Tower/AWX), and Git-driven CI/CD systems.Scripting & Development: Advanced scripting abilities in Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell for custom API integrations and operational tooling.Resiliency & DR: Proven experience automating enterprise backup, snapshotting, and disaster recovery architectures (Veeam, Velero, Zerto, or native storage replication).Observability: Strong working knowledge of telemetry pipelines, SNMP/gNMI collectors, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK/OpenSearch dashboards. Physical DemandsDuties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required. Typical Experience12 to 15 years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, network operations, and DevOps. 3+ years in a people management or technical lead capacity. Typical EducationBachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience. Educational requirements may vary by geography. NotesThis job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.Celestica is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on any protected status (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran or disability status or other characteristics protected by law).At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them.Company OverviewCelestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages.Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments: Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC):ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions.CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth.Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
As AI Automation Specialist with a strong passion for AI-native software engineering and hands-on expertise in Agentic AI, Generative AI, and autonomous development frameworks. The ideal candidate will be capable of translating business requirements into production-ready applications by leveraging AI-powered development workflows, multi-agent systems, and modern software engineering practices. This role requires the ability to rapidly design, build, test, and deploy customer-specific software solutions using a combination of strong programming skills, telecom OSS knowledge, and AI-assisted development tools.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI-native, cloud-native, and web-based applications using Go, Java, Python, microservices, and distributed system architectures.
* Build end-to-end software solutions using Agentic AI frameworks, LLMs, and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery.
* Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, automation platforms, and enterprise applications using Spring Boot and event-driven architectures.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents, multi-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and intelligent copilots to automate engineering and business processes.
* Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, RAG pipelines, MCP-based integrations, and AI assistants into telecom OSS and enterprise applications.
* Leverage AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT for code generation, testing, debugging, documentation, and deployment.
* Build scalable, secure, and resilient applications using Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and modern cloud-native technologies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver customer-specific solutions, optimize performance and code quality, and adopt emerging AI technologies to improve productivity and innovation.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) with 5–10 years of relevant software engineering experience and the ability to design, develop, and deliver production-ready software solutions.
* Strong proficiency in Go and/or Java, with expertise in microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native development.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, and MCP-based integrations.
* Expertise in AI coding assistants and autonomous development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude to accelerate software development.

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Ability to build intelligent applications integrating AI-driven reasoning, orchestration, and automation with traditional software engineering.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud-native architectures, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, scalability, engineering best practices, and end-to-end solution development.
* Telecom OSS/BSS experience and knowledge of NETCONF, RESTCONF, YANG, network automation, and AI integration into enterprise applications are strong advantages.

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.
  
  
This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.
* Task-completion and appropriate-escalation rates.
* Production defect and regression rates.
* Retrieval and grounding quality.
* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.
* Reuse of standard components.
* Completeness of technical documentation and automated testing.
* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role engineers the behavior of AI applications. Practice SMEs remain accountable for defining and validating authoritative professional content, business rules, acceptable conclusions, and circumstances requiring human review.

title: NAP Network Test Automation Development Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As Network Test Automation Development Engineer is responsible for designing and developing scalable, intelligent test automation solutions for complex network systems. This role combines strong networking expertise with modern automation, CI/CD, and AI/ML technologies to ensure high quality, reliability, and faster delivery of carrier-grade, cloud-native network products.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for functional, regression, performance, and end‑to‑end network testing.
* Develop automated test suites using Python, Java, or Go with frameworks such as Robot Framework, pytest, and Selenium.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and faster release cycles.
* Apply AI/ML techniques for intelligent test case generation, anomaly detection, predictive defect analysis, and self‑healing automation.
* Analyze large volumes of test and network data to identify patterns, trends, and quality risks.
* Develop AI‑driven tools for network test data analysis, insights, and visualization.
* Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to ensure testability and timely defect resolution.
* Contribute to test strategy, code reviews, design discussions, and maintain automation documentation.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* Bachelor degree with 8–12 years of relevant experience. 7+ years of experience with strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Go for test automation and tool development.
* Hands‑on experience with test automation frameworks such as Robot Framework, pytest, Selenium, and Postman.
* Solid understanding of network protocols and architectures (TCP/IP, IP/MPLS, Routing & Switching, SDN/NFV, 4G/5G).
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts applied to automation or data analysis.
* Exposure to ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit‑learn.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and container technologies (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, communication, and cross‑functional collaboration skills.
